event.title: Nine Killed in Learjet Crash Near Palm Beach, Florida
event.canonical_title: Nine Killed in Learjet Crash Near Palm Beach, Florida
event.summary: A Learjet crashed in a residential neighborhood in Palm Beach County, Florida, on Sunday, killing all nine people on board. The aircraft reportedly plummeted to the ground, resulting in a significant explosion. Investigators from the NTSB are examining evidence suggesting that parts of the jet may have broken off before the crash, with weather conditions also being a major focus of the investigation.
